name: The Coming End: Fresh Force Frustrations (A Gay Superhero Visual Novel)
source:
Empath joins Fresh Force, a team of sidekicks hoping to become full superheroes one day. A sudden blackout leaves him, his teammates, and the rest of the world unable to get physically aroused. 

A tentacle creature attack their headquarters, leaving the Fresh Force trapped and desperate to find the traitor who let the attack succeed. Empath needs to learn about his teammates, and figure out who to trust and who to arouse!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2479010/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“共感者”加入了“新生力量”，这是一支由英雄助手组成的队伍，成员都希望有朝一日成为独当一面的超级英雄。一次突如其来的断电，让他、队友，以及世界上的所有人，都无法在身体上产生性兴奋。

一只触手生物袭击总部，让新生力量陷入困境，急于找出让袭击得逞的叛徒。共感者必须了解队友，弄清谁值得信任，又该唤起谁的欲望！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2479010/]Steam[/url]]
